newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $201 mln on Wednesday Jan 29.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $201 mln on Wednesday Jan 29.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales for Wednesday January 29 are expected to total $201 million in 17 offerings, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $107 million in 13 sales. The largest is a $33 million Maryland National Capital Park issue at 1100 EST.
Negotiated sales total $94 million in four offerings. The largest is a $39 million Kansas DFA, Kan., revenue bond issue through George K Baum.
